title: A1 Swaara v1.0.6 - Cloud Sync, Shared Playlists and Live Jam Rooms
changelog:
- Cloud Sync and Backup: Seamlessly backup and restore favorites, custom playlists, and song history to the cloud with anonymous device identity and device linking
- Shareable Playlists: Publish playlists to generate 6-digit share codes (SWxxxx) and import friends playlists instantly
- Listen Together (Live Jam Rooms): Real-time synchronized playback with friends using 6-digit room codes (JAMxxx)
- Community Trending Charts: Crowdsourced song play tracking and real-time community leaderboard
- Cloud Dynamic Config: Fallback stream proxies and broadcast announcements without needing app updates
